scope: New non-hardware solids, including cropped source rails and floor. Thread mating excluded; nominal CAD only. Not a complete tolerance, weld or passenger-envelope test.
mass_inclusions: Catalog HSS + CAD plate/nominal hardware; excludes upholstery, finish, sealing boots, small panel hardware and all undeveloped local reinforcements.
browser_limit: No supported connected browser QA was available in this run. JavaScript syntax, actual viewer schema/part-offset logic, CAD validity and rendered drawing checks are distinct; mouse/touch rotation is not claimed visually tested.

reader_check.method: Rendered and visually inspected all four coordinated drawings; cross-checked materials, part families, hole patterns and final 3/4-inch stack. Fixed pan titles to5052-H32aluminum.
reader_check.builder_can_identify: Individual frame pieces, nominal cut lengths, mount plates/spacers/fastener stack and which face mates to each.
reader_check.cannot_build_without_further_definition: Final weld procedures/effective lengths, joint acceptance, locking/preload, panel fasteners, trim and floor closeouts remain incomplete; no production release.
